obligations.obligation: Each stage invokes /until-loop by name with an argument naming the ShipLoop-written contract and receipt; the loop must start from that file unchanged.
obligations.where: ADAPTER.md (skills/improve/runtime/until-loop) and the installed until-loop@whichguy 0.7.0 SKILL.md set disable-model-invocation: true, so the Skill tool refuses the call; and the card's '## Interpret the request before starting' tells the executor to interpret natural language and build its own contract, which would reinterpret the stage's words.
obligations.fix: Card changes (both copies, released together): (1) disable-model-invocation: false (keep user-invocable: true). (2) A new first section '## Start from a parent-written contract': 'When the argument names a Contract file, skip interpretation: do not build, edit or re-serialise a contract. Run exactly python3 <this card's scripts/until_loop_ephemeral.py> start --receipt <Receipt> < <Contract>. The Work/Exit/Repeat lines in the argument are a copy for reading; if they differ from the file, the file wins. If the Receipt exists: active -> run its next_argv once; complete or stopped -> return to the parent; never start a second run. Follow "Follow the returned action" for each packet; the parent submits its own callback.' (3) argument-hint gains '| Contract: <abs path> Receipt: <abs path>'. (4) description adds 'or start a parent-written contract file'. ShipLoop side: the check at complete compares the terminal packet with the contract rebuilt from state, so a reinterpreted contract is refused with the exact start command (start_command) to rerun. The 'on any host, open the card' fallback needs the same section. Cost: the Skill tool loads the whole 18.9 KB card on each invocation (8+ per item); put the parent-contract section first and say 'read no further sections unless a packet needs them'.

obligations.obligation: A loop on a stage that usually needs one iteration.
obligations.where: Not estimated in the drafts.
obligations.fix: One clean iteration adds: the Skill call or card read (first time per context), the start command, one report JSON plus its done_argv call, and the receipt read at complete: about 3 tool calls and 1-3 KB of report per stage, on stages that took 1-3 turns live (implement 3 turns/step, document 2, verify 1; diagnosis doc medians). Per item: ~8 stages + N implement steps -> roughly 25-35 extra tool calls, versus 9 stage packets/results/callbacks removed by decision 6. Mitigations: required_trivial_reviews 0 (one pass suffices when exit holds); the card's parent-contract section first so the card is read once per context; report_schema minimal; ShipLoop prefills the receipt and prints done_argv's shape. Implement steps also run an Improve child (required_trivial_reviews 2, unchanged-first-pass shortcut), so a step has two loops; owner may let the step's Improve child be the step's only loop (implement's own loop then just runs the check commands once).
